A commit message you create must not contain a Co-Authored-By: trailer, or any other co-author or attribution trailer. Do not add one yourself, and do not ask a delegated executor to add one. This covers new commits only: never rewrite history or strip trailers from existing commits, and keep the project's configured git author and committer unchanged.

STATIC REVIEW ONLY (read-only delegation): Do not modify, create, or delete files. Do not run shell commands, tests, builds, or other gates. Text analysis only.

reply OK
OK. I’ll treat this as read-only: no file changes, no shell commands, and I won’t add co-author or attribution trailers to new commit messages or ask others to.
